title: JPCERT AI-assisted attacks Japan breach wave
summary: PIR-1: yes, but not in the alert. JPCERT/CC's alert of 8 October (JPCERT-AT-2026-0030) never mentions AI (C-001). The AI statement appears a week later, on 15 October, in a JPCERT/CC Eyes blog post by its Attack Infrastructure Investigation Team.
